reference.title: FOCUS cost and usage details file schema (Version 1.2-preview)

additional_sources.title: Details about the FOCUS dataset (FinOps toolkit metadata)
Details about the FOCUS dataset - official metadata JSON (dataset-metadata.zip / FocusCost_1.2-preview.json)

delivery.partition_data: always enabled; one file per partition, uncompressed size under 1 GB
delivery.manifest: _manifest.json in the same folder as the data files

columns.name: BilledCost
columns.description: A charge serving as the basis for invoicing, inclusive of all reduced rates and discounts while excluding the amortization of upfront charges (one-time or recurring).

columns.name: BillingAccountId
columns.description: Unique identifier assigned to a billing account by the provider.

columns.name: BillingAccountName
columns.description: Display name assigned to a billing account.

columns.name: BillingAccountType
columns.description: Provider label for the kind of entity the BillingAccountId represents.

columns.name: BillingCurrency
columns.description: Currency that a charge was billed in.

columns.name: BillingPeriodEnd
columns.description: Exclusive end date and time of the billing period.

columns.name: BillingPeriodStart
columns.description: Inclusive start date and time of the billing period.

columns.name: CapacityReservationId
columns.description: Unique identifier assigned to a capacity reservation by the provider.
columns.notes: Documented as "Currently null/empty" in the Cost Management FOCUS 1.2-preview dataset.

columns.name: CapacityReservationStatus
columns.description: Indicates whether the charge represents either the consumption of a capacity reservation or when a capacity reservation is unused.
columns.notes: Documented as "Currently null/empty" in the Cost Management FOCUS 1.2-preview dataset.

columns.name: ChargeCategory
columns.description: Highest-level classification of a charge based on the nature of how it is billed.

columns.name: ChargeClass
columns.description: Indicates whether the row represents a correction to one or more charges invoiced in a previous billing period.

columns.name: ChargeDescription
columns.description: Self-contained summary of the charge's purpose and price.

columns.name: ChargeFrequency
columns.description: Indicates how often a charge will occur.

columns.name: ChargePeriodEnd
columns.description: Exclusive end date and time of a charge period.

columns.name: ChargePeriodStart
columns.description: Inclusive start date and time of a charge period.

columns.name: CommitmentDiscountCategory
columns.description: Indicates whether the commitment-based discount identified in the CommitmentDiscountId column is based on usage quantity or cost (aka spend).

columns.name: CommitmentDiscountId
columns.description: Unique identifier assigned to a commitment-based discount by the provider.

columns.name: CommitmentDiscountName
columns.description: Display name assigned to a commitment-based discount.

columns.name: CommitmentDiscountQuantity
columns.description: Amount of a commitment discount purchased or accounted for in commitment discount related rows that is denominated in Commitment Discount Units.
columns.notes: Documented as "Currently null/empty" in the Cost Management FOCUS 1.2-preview dataset.

columns.name: CommitmentDiscountStatus
columns.description: Indicates whether the charge corresponds with the consumption of a commitment-based discount or the unused portion of the committed amount.
columns.notes: Documented as "Currently null/empty" in the Cost Management FOCUS 1.2-preview dataset.

columns.name: CommitmentDiscountType
columns.description: Label assigned by the provider to describe the type of commitment-based discount applied to the row.

columns.name: CommitmentDiscountUnit
columns.description: Provider-specified measurement unit indicating how a provider measures the CommitmentDiscountQuantity of a commitment discount.
columns.notes: Documented as "Currently null/empty" in the Cost Management FOCUS 1.2-preview dataset.

columns.name: ConsumedQuantity
columns.description: Volume of a given SKU associated with a resource or service used, based on the Consumed Unit.

columns.name: ConsumedUnit
columns.description: Provider-specified measurement unit indicating how a provider measures usage of a given SKU associated with a resource or service.

columns.name: ContractedCost
columns.description: Cost calculated by multiplying contracted unit price and the corresponding Pricing Quantity.

columns.name: ContractedUnitPrice
columns.description: The agreed-upon unit price for a single Pricing Unit of the associated SKU, inclusive of negotiated discounts, if present, while excluding negotiated commitment-based discounts or any other discounts.

columns.name: EffectiveCost
columns.description: The amortized cost of the charge after applying all reduced rates, discounts, and the applicable portion of relevant, prepaid purchases (one-time or recurring) that covered this charge.

columns.name: InvoiceId
columns.description: Unique identifier for the invoice this charge was billed on.

columns.name: InvoiceIssuerName
columns.description: The name of the entity responsible for invoicing for the resources or services consumed.

columns.name: ListCost
columns.description: Cost calculated by multiplying List Unit Price and the corresponding Pricing Quantity.

columns.name: ListUnitPrice
columns.description: Suggested provider-published unit price for a single Pricing Unit of the associated SKU, exclusive of any discounts.

columns.name: PricingCategory
columns.description: Describes the pricing model used for a charge at the time of use or purchase.

columns.name: PricingCurrency
columns.description: Currency that the charge was priced in by the provider.

columns.name: PricingQuantity
columns.description: Volume of a given SKU associated with a resource or service used or purchased, based on the Pricing Unit.

columns.name: PricingUnit
columns.description: Provider-specified measurement unit for determining unit prices, indicating how the provider rates measured usage and purchase quantities after applying pricing rules like block pricing.

columns.name: ProviderName
columns.description: Name of the entity that made the resources and/or services available for purchase.

columns.name: PublisherName
columns.description: Name of the entity that produced the resources and/or services that were purchased.

columns.name: RegionId
columns.description: Provider-assigned identifier for an isolated geographic area where a resource is provisioned or a service is provided.

columns.name: RegionName
columns.description: Name of an isolated geographic area where a resource is provisioned or a service is provided.

columns.name: ResourceId
columns.description: Unique identifier assigned to a resource by the provider.

columns.name: ResourceName
columns.description: Display name assigned to a resource.

columns.name: ResourceType
columns.description: The kind of resource for which you are being charged.

columns.name: ServiceCategory
columns.description: Highest-level classification of a service based on the core function of the service.

columns.name: ServiceName
columns.description: An offering that can be purchased from a provider (for example, cloud virtual machine, SaaS database, professional services from a systems integrator).

columns.name: ServiceSubcategory
columns.description: Secondary classification of the ServiceCategory for a service based on its core function.

columns.name: SkuId
columns.description: Unique identifier that defines a provider-supported construct for organizing properties that are common across one or more SKU Prices.

columns.name: SkuMeter
columns.description: Describes the functionality being metered or measured by a particular SKU in a charge. This usually maps to a specific SKU or range of SKUs that have a specific price. Same as MeterName. Not available for some purchases.

columns.name: SkuPriceDetails
columns.description: A set of properties of a SkuPriceId which are meaningful and common to all instances of that SkuPriceId. This column is formatted as a JSON object. Same as AdditionalInfo.
columns.notes: Documented as "Currently null/empty" in the Cost Management FOCUS 1.2-preview dataset.

columns.name: SkuPriceId
columns.description: Unique identifier that defines the unit price used to calculate the charge.

columns.name: SubAccountId
columns.description: Unique identifier assigned to a grouping of resources and/or services, often used to manage access and/or cost.

columns.name: SubAccountName
columns.description: Name assigned to a grouping of resources and/or services, often used to manage access and/or cost.

columns.name: SubAccountType
columns.description: Provider label for the kind of entity the SubAccountId represents.

columns.name: Tags
columns.description: List of custom key-value pairs applied to a charge defined as a JSON object.

columns.name: x_AccountId
columns.description: Unique identifier for the identity responsible for billing for this subscription. This is your EA enrollment account owner or MOSA account admin. Not applicable to MCA.

columns.name: x_AccountName
columns.description: Name of the identity responsible for billing for this subscription. This is your EA enrollment account owner or MOSA account admin. Not applicable to MCA.

columns.name: x_AccountOwnerId
columns.description: Email address of the identity responsible for billing for this subscription. This is your EA enrollment account owner or MOSA account admin. Not applicable to MCA.

columns.name: x_AmortizationClass
columns.description: Indicates how a row relates to amortization to identify and distinguish between the charges before and after amortization is applied.

columns.name: x_BilledCostInUsd
columns.description: BilledCost in USD.

columns.name: x_BilledUnitPrice
columns.description: Unit price for a single Pricing Unit of the associated SKU that was charged per unit.

columns.name: x_BillingAccountId
columns.description: Unique identifier for the Microsoft billing account. Same as BillingAccountId for EA.

columns.name: x_BillingAccountName
columns.description: Name of the Microsoft billing account. Same as BillingAccountName for EA.

columns.name: x_BillingExchangeRate
columns.description: Exchange rate to multiply by when converting from the pricing currency to the billing currency.

columns.name: x_BillingExchangeRateDate
columns.description: Date the exchange rate was determined.

columns.name: x_BillingProfileId
columns.description: Unique identifier for the Microsoft billing profile. Same as BillingAccountId for MCA.

columns.name: x_BillingProfileName
columns.description: Name of the Microsoft billing profile. Same as BillingAccountName for MCA.

columns.name: x_ContractedCostInUsd
columns.description: ContractedCost in USD.

columns.name: x_CostAllocationRuleName
columns.description: Name of the Microsoft Cost Management cost allocation rule that generated this charge. Cost allocation is used to move or split shared charges.

columns.name: x_CostCenter
columns.description: Custom value defined by a billing admin for internal chargeback.

columns.name: x_CustomerId
columns.description: Unique identifier for the Cloud Solution Provider (CSP) customer tenant.

columns.name: x_CustomerName
columns.description: Display name for the Cloud Solution Provider (CSP) customer tenant.

columns.name: x_EffectiveCostInUsd
columns.description: EffectiveCost in USD.

columns.name: x_EffectiveUnitPrice
columns.description: Unit price for a single Pricing Unit of the associated SKU after applying all reduced rates, discounts, and the applicable portion of relevant, prepaid purchases (one-time or recurring) that covered this charge.

columns.name: x_InvoiceIssuerId
columns.description: Unique identifier for the Cloud Solution Provider (CSP) partner.
columns.notes: Present in the official FinOps toolkit FocusCost_1.2-preview metadata JSON as String, but not listed on the Cost Management FOCUS 1.2-preview schema page. Type verified from metadata JSON only.

columns.name: x_InvoiceSectionId
columns.description: Unique identifier for the MCA invoice section or EA department.

columns.name: x_InvoiceSectionName
columns.description: Display name for the MCA invoice section or EA department.

columns.name: x_ListCostInUsd
columns.description: ListCost in USD.

columns.name: x_PartnerCreditApplied
columns.description: Indicates when the Cloud Solution Provider (CSP) Partner Earned Credit (PEC) was applied for a charge.

columns.name: x_PartnerCreditRate
columns.description: Rate earned based on the Cloud Solution Provider (CSP) Partner Earned Credit (PEC) applied.

columns.name: x_PricingBlockSize
columns.description: Indicates the number of usage units grouped together for block pricing. This number is usually a part of the PricingUnit. Divide UsageQuantity by PricingBlockSize to get the PricingQuantity.

columns.name: x_PricingSubcategory
columns.description: Describes the kind of pricing model used for a charge within a specific Pricing Category.

columns.name: x_PricingUnitDescription
columns.description: Indicates what measurement type is used by the PricingQuantity, including pricing block size. This is what is used in the price list and/or on the invoice.

columns.name: x_PublisherCategory
columns.description: Indicates whether a charge is from a cloud provider or third-party Marketplace vendor.

columns.name: x_PublisherId
columns.description: Unique identifier of the entity that produced the resources and/or services that were purchased.

columns.name: x_ResellerId
columns.description: Unique identifier for the Cloud Solution Provider (CSP) reseller.

columns.name: x_ResellerName
columns.description: Name of the Cloud Solution Provider (CSP) reseller.

columns.name: x_ResourceGroupName
columns.description: Grouping of resources that make up an application or set of resources that share the same lifecycle (for example, created and deleted together).

columns.name: x_ResourceType
columns.description: Azure Resource Manager resource type.

columns.name: x_ServiceModel
columns.description: Indicates what aspects of the service are managed by the provider – infrastructure only, the platform custom code runs on, or the entire service.

columns.name: x_ServicePeriodEnd
columns.description: Exclusive end date of the service period applicable for the charge.

columns.name: x_ServicePeriodStart
columns.description: Start date of the service period applicable for the charge.

columns.name: x_SkuDescription
columns.description: Description of the SKU that was used or purchased.

columns.name: x_SkuDetails
columns.description: Additional information about the SKU. This column is formatted as a JSON object.

columns.name: x_SkuIsCreditEligible
columns.description: Indicates if the charge is eligible for Azure credits

columns.name: x_SkuMeterCategory
columns.description: Name of the service the SKU falls within.

columns.name: x_SkuMeterId
columns.description: Unique identifier (sometimes a GUID, but not always) for the usage meter. This usually maps to a specific SKU or range of SKUs that have a specific price.

columns.name: x_SkuMeterName
columns.description: Name of the usage meter. This usually maps to a specific SKU or range of SKUs that have a specific price. Not applicable for purchases.

columns.name: x_SkuMeterSubcategory
columns.description: Group of SKU Classes that address the same core need within the SKU Group.

columns.name: x_SkuOfferId
columns.description: Microsoft Cloud subscription type.

columns.name: x_SkuOrderId
columns.description: Unique identifier of the entitlement product for this charge. Same as MCA ProductOrderId. Not applicable for EA.

columns.name: x_SkuOrderName
columns.description: Display name of the entitlement product for this charge. Same as MCA ProductOrderId. Not applicable for EA.

columns.name: x_SkuPartNumber
columns.description: Identifier to help break down specific usage meters.

columns.name: x_SkuPlanName
columns.description: Name of the Marketplace service plan.

columns.name: x_SkuRegion
columns.description: Region that the SKU operated in. This may be different from the resource region.

columns.name: x_SkuServiceFamily
columns.description: Highest-level classification of a SKU based on the core function of the SKU.

columns.name: x_SkuTerm
columns.description: Number of months a purchase covers.
columns.notes: Present in the official FocusCost_1.2-preview metadata JSON (Number) and in the metadata page table, but absent from the Cost Management FOCUS 1.2-preview schema page.

columns.name: x_SkuTier
columns.description: Pricing tier for the SKU when that SKU supports tiered or graduated pricing.

unverified.name: x_PricingCurrency
unverified.reason: Listed as column 79 in the Cost Management FOCUS 1.2-preview schema page, but absent from the official FinOps toolkit FocusCost_1.2-preview metadata JSON (106 columns) that Microsoft links from the same documentation. Casing/type and presence are therefore contradictory between two official Microsoft sources.

unverified.name: column order
unverified.reason: The schema page enumerates columns 1-105 while the official metadata JSON enumerates 106 columns; the two orders disagree from index 73 onward (x_InvoiceIssuerId, x_SkuTerm, x_SkuPlanName/x_SkuPartNumber). No single authoritative order can be cited.
